title: Confidence-Based Decoding is Provably Efficient for Diffusion Language Models

summary.en: Analyzes an adaptive decoding strategy that limits cumulative prediction entropy within each iteration. KL-accuracy guarantees connect the expected number of sampling rounds to target-distribution entropy, explaining how confidence can guide efficient parallel token generation under the paper’s assumptions.
summary.zh: 分析一种按每轮累计预测熵决定揭示 token 数量的自适应解码策略。论文将 KL 采样精度、预期生成轮数与目标分布熵联系起来，为置信度引导的并行生成提供理论依据。

cover.alt: Animated conceptual overview of Confidence-Based Decoding: Prediction entropy; Adaptive selection; Parallel unmasking.
